Next Best Moves

Complete these moves in order and keep a written record of every carrier conversation, submission, and decision. Do not rely on a verbal answer when provider eligibility, claim timing, or reimbursement is involved.

OrderAction & Detailed InstructionsCompletion EvidenceTarget
1Verify the carrier record and all filing deadlines.
Confirm the carrier’s current claims phone number, mailing address, fax number, secure portal, policy status, policy number, and the state under which the policy was issued. Ask specifically about notice-of-claim, proof-of-loss, assessment, and appeal deadlines. Record the representative’s name, date, time, and reference number.		Written carrier contact sheet, deadline calendar, and call log with reference number.Immediately
Days 1–2
2Open the claim and establish one accountable carrier contact.
Start the claim or pre-claim review, obtain the claim number, and request the assigned case manager’s direct contact information. Request the carrier’s current claim forms, authorization forms, assessment process, benefit-trigger criteria, and a written list of every document required for review.		Claim or pre-claim number, case-manager contact, current forms, and written requirements checklist.Start promptly
By Day 15
3Build the elimination-period care and funding plan.
Confirm whether the 90-day elimination period counts calendar days, service days, or only eligible paid-care days. Estimate the temporary out-of-pocket reserve, identify the funding source, and begin a daily log of care received, provider hours, invoices, and proof of payment from the first potentially qualifying day.		Written counting rule, reserved funds, care calendar, invoice file, and payment log.Before care begins
Then track daily
First checkpointDo not sign a long-term care agreement or assume a service day will count toward the elimination period until the carrier’s counting method and provider rules have been confirmed.

Verify current information. Confirm claim forms, contact details, deadlines, benefit triggers, elimination-period rules, provider requirements, reimbursement procedures, appeal rights, and remaining benefits through a verified carrier channel.

Estimates and privacy. Costs, timelines, care needs, inflation, rates, and projected savings may change. Transmit medical and policy records securely, verify the recipient, retain confirmation, and do not send a full Social Security number through unsecured channels.
